_comment_nvidia_gpu: Deliberately NOT named 'gpu': Create-TAPPaaS-LXC.sh fires its AMD-shaped passthrough block on any non-empty .gpu key and would write malformed conf lines (empty kfd/render majors) that break pct start. This module's patch-host-gpu.sh owns the NVIDIA passthrough conf instead.
_comment_host_driver_pin: Driver version patch-host-gpu.sh auto-installs when the host has an NVIDIA GPU but no working driver. R580 is the last branch supporting Pascal/Volta; bump for newer cards.
